set.body:
Outcome
Make the modules independently consumable with honest support and provenance.

Owned scope
packaging; clean consumer fixtures; README/API/style docs; notices

Prerequisites
C4, C5

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Produce exact local candidate artifacts and inspect POM/JAR dependency closure; theme-only Java consumer does not acquire ScalaDock/ScalaFX, adapter Scala consumer obtains only its declared closure.
- [ ] Build/run consumers outside sibling checkouts in an isolated local repository; no SNAPSHOT, hidden local-composite dependency or development path is required.
- [ ] Include all generated resources, source/license/font/icon notices; verify CSS URLs resolve from packaged JARs, including popup/float construction and shaded/module-path arrangements actually claimed.
- [ ] Document installation, theme switching, density/text scale, lifetime/disposal, semantic style API, adapter contract, runtime/support matrix and application migration boundaries with compiled examples.
- [ ] State pre-release maturity, tested versions and limitations accurately; producing local candidate artifacts does not publish them.

Required evidence
POM/JAR inspection, clean Java and Scala consumer logs, compiled docs examples, license/resource inventory and exact artifact digests.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code D6. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [D6] Qualify artifacts, Java/Scala consumers and adoption documentation
